verdict.rationale: Box's documented primitives cover the core data-room needs: shared links with configurable access levels for view-only sharing (box-docs-3, box-docs-36, box-docs-24), collaborations for granular folder-level access control (box-docs-4, box-docs-21, box-docs-37), webhooks specifically triggered on file downloads (box-docs-22), and an events/audit feed for access visibility (box-docs-8, box-docs-19, box-docs-39). Community evidence corroborates real-world use for selectively granting outside parties access to files/folders (box-comm-9), matching the diligence-sharing use case. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party 'data room' template/feature, documentation of disabling downloads specifically (vs. just notifying on download), and independent hands-on validation of the full workflow (folder org + view-only + download-block + audit) as a single cohesive experience.
